title: chore(website): remove documentation from website
body:
This removes the documentation process from the website.

## Changes

* Add Netlify redirections to Algolia documentation
* Move examples to static folder `website/examples` (removed Sass steps)
* Remove `docgen` folder
* Remove development dependencies

### Links

* Main website goes to Algolia documentation: https://deploy-preview-3396--instantsearchjs.netlify.com
* Stories: https://deploy-preview-3396--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories
* Examples list goes to Algolia documentation: https://deploy-preview-3396--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/
* Examples:
  * https://deploy-preview-3396--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/
  * https://deploy-preview-3396--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/tourism/
  * https://deploy-preview-3396--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/media/
  * https://deploy-preview-3396--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/calendar-widget/

***

The documentation can be safely removed from the source code in other PRs.
